acceptance_algorithm: Verify journal hash chain, sequence continuity, transaction_id, contract_sha256, and current supervisor epoch.
Reconstruct or verify the canonical idempotency map from the journal before accepting proposals.
Use ProgressDB only if its indexed head exactly equals the verified journal head.
If the key is absent, validate the proposal and append at most one canonical event.
If the key exists with the same proposal_sha256, return the original durable ACK without appending.
If the key exists with a different proposal_sha256, reject as a conflicting duplicate and append no semantic event.
invariants: Idempotent retry does not create another semantic event.
ProgressDB can accelerate only when journal-head equality is proven.
A missing ACK delivery does not permit duplicate append after durable journal commit.
Canonical idempotency state survives deletion of every projection and index.
